result.description: A fictional productivity monitor designed for immersive spreadsheets, document editing, and timeline work. The Nebra Loom pairs a 34.0-inch ultrawide IPS panel with a 3440x1440 resolution, 100Hz refresh rate, and integrated eye-comfort tuning for long sessions. It includes USB-C video input, dual HDMI ports, a DisplayPort input, and a simple height-adjustable stand. This model is aimed at office and creator workflows rather than gaming or workstation graphics.
result.title: Nebra Loom 34.0-inch Ultrawide Office Monitor
